title: Users may be unable to open Microsoft 365 Copilot in Microsoft Teams meetings on the iOS app
impact: Users may have been unable to open Copilot in Microsoft Teams meetings on the iOS app.

updates.content:
Title: Users may be unable to open Microsoft 365 Copilot in Microsoft Teams meetings on the iOS app

User impact: Users may be unable to open Copilot in Microsoft Teams meetings on the iOS app.

More info: After users confirm the Copilot start prompt and select the meeting language, Copilot appears to start but may remain inactive, and meeting participants may not receive the "Copilot has started" notification. Subsequent attempts may prompt users to repeat the same steps, but Copilot may still fail to start.

Current status: We’re reviewing details provided by a subset of affected users determine the next steps needed to resolve this issue.

Scope of impact: Any users attempting to open Copilot in Microsoft Teams meetings on the iOS app may be impacted.

Next update by: Friday, November 20, 2026, at 2:00 PM UTC

Title: Users may be unable to open Microsoft 365 Copilot in Microsoft Teams meetings on the iOS app

User impact: Users may have been unable to open Copilot in Microsoft Teams meetings on the iOS app.

More info: After users confirmed the Copilot start prompt and selected the meeting language, Copilot appeared to start but may have remained inactive, and meeting participants may not have received the "Copilot has started" notification. Subsequent attempts may have prompted users to repeat the same steps, but Copilot may still have failed to start. 

Impact was specific to users that had the Copilot policy configured to "On" and the transcription policy configured to "Off." Affected users also had meetings setup in Copilot using the "Only during the meeting" mode.

Affected users could have manually updated their Microsoft Teams app to version 8.21.0 or above from the Apple App Store to acquire the fix more quickly and resolve impact.

Final status: We've found that impact was specific to users that had the Copilot policy configured and the transcription policy configured off. Affected users also had meetings setup in Copilot using the "Only during the meeting" mode. We also determined that there was a code issue in the Microsoft Teams app version 8.20.0, which prevented the Copilot service from starting. After releasing the Microsoft Teams app versions 8.21.0 and above, which contains the fix, we confirmed that it successful remediates the impact. The updated version is available for all affected users in the Apple App Store and in order to obtain the fix, users need to manually install the updated version.

Scope of impact: Users who had the Copilot policy configured to "On," the transcription policy configured to "Off," and had meetings setup in Copilot using the "Only during the meeting" mode may have been impacted.

Start time: Tuesday, October 27, 2026, at 12:00 AM UTC

End time: Saturday, November 21, 2026, at 1:38 AM UTC

Root cause: There was a code issue in the Microsoft Teams app version 8.20.0, which prevented the Copilot service from starting and caused impact.

Next steps: 
- We're reviewing our app version update testing and validation procedures to identify and prevent similar code issues that prevent Copilot service from starting from occurring in future app deployments.

This is the final update for this event.
